data.name: Dnyneshwar
data.gender_notes: Dnyneshwar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: DNYANESHWAR is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words - DNYANA (knowledge) and ISHWAR (God). It refers to the Supreme God, the Lord of the universe, who bestows the knowledge and wisdom to his devotees. The name Dnyneshwar carries the meaning “Lord of the universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dnyneshwar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the quest for knowledge and the pursuit of divine wisdom.
data.etymology: Dnyneshwar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dnyneshwar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: Dnyaneshwar is a revered figure in Indian tradition, particularly in the Maharashtra region. He is known as a poet-saint and is considered a major figure in the Bhakti movement, which emphasized the importance of personal devotion to God in daily life. The iconic, 33-canto work "Dnyaneshwari" is attributed to him- a Marathi language commentary and translation of the Sanskrit original "Shri Bhagavad Gita". The profound, yet accessible wisdom in this commentary has deeply influenced both the Hindu and Marathi communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Dnyaneshwar carries deep spiritual significance as it evokes the essence of Divine Knowledge. The term "Dnyan" in the name alludes to wisdom that comes straight from the divine source as a bestowal from God. "Ishwar" signifies the God or supreme consciousness that gives this knowledge. Adoring and connecting with the name Dnyaneshwar is an invitation to draw closer to the divine wisdom, awakening the mind and creating a strong bond between the devotee and the deity. Thus, the name embodies the act of surrendering oneself to the higher knowledge and inner wisdom.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dnyaneshwar, meaning 'the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom', symbolizes the enlightened soul who has realized the ultimate truth of life beyond illusion and ignorance. This name is a reminder of the spiritual journey towards self-realization and the pursuit of wisdom and knowledge as the means to attain it.

historical_references.reference: Dnyaneshwar was a 13th century Marathi poet and saint. He is considered an incarnation of the Hindu god Dattatreya.

trends: Dnyaneshwar is a popular name for boys in India.
The name Dnyaneshwar is also used as a title for various Hindu deities and spiritual leaders.
modern_usage.modern_context: In modern usage, the name Dnyaneshwar is often used as a personal name and as a title for various Hindu deities and spiritual leaders. It is also commonly found in Indian culture and is popular in various social media platforms.
